description: This PHP source file defines the SecurityGroupUserRelationship class, which models the relationship between security groups and users within the system, including methods for fetching related data and constructing database queries.

classes.name: SecurityGroupUserRelationship
classes.description: A class representing the relationship between security groups and users, with fields for IDs, flags, and related data tags, and methods for loading detailed information and creating database queries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes database connections and disables row level security for the relationship object.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates the security group name and user name fields by querying the database based on stored IDs.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query to retrieve user list data, optionally filtered by provided conditions and ordered by last and first name.
